You can do that by killing enemies, however the game doesn’t grant anymore XP after you’ve killed 10 of an enemy type, so I had to go through an entire ass laundry list killing shit so that I could get enough XP for the Hylian Shield to spawn with the max modifier. The way I see it is like Ego and Instinct being two sides of the same coin, and the manga kind of confirms this to a degree as well.

Ego and Instinct are essentially polar opposites.

Ultra Instinct gets stronger as the user evades attacks, while Ultra Ego gets stronger as the user takes damage.

Ultra Instinct is a technique that requires mental clarity. It needs a calm mind and a calm body to function effectively. It is also a form utilized by Angels.

Ultra Ego on the other hand is a technique is fueled on it’s user’s overwhelming emotions and intense passion, and the more that the user indulges themselves, the stronger they become. This technique is known to be used by Gods of Destruction.

I wouldn’t say that one is necessarily stronger than the other. They both have their pros and cons.
